title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
lede: Signal is extending its Windows screenshot block to Android and iOS, arguing that operating systems with built-in AI agents can read the screen and move private chats beyond the app's control.

points: President Meredith Whittaker called OS-level agentic AI an existential threat to Signal's privacy promise.
Her case: when Windows, Android, macOS or iOS let an agent scan the screen, captured messages can land in whatever database or server that agent uses.
Signal already blocked screenshots in its Windows app by default; the mobile apps now get a similar restriction.
Users can turn the setting off, which Whittaker says breaks Signal's privacy guarantees.
She calls it an incomplete fix, since agents may reach app data in less visible ways.

sections.text: Assistants that work by reading the screen depend on apps letting them see it. Signal opting out signals that privacy-focused apps may treat OS agents as a threat, leaving those agents blind in exactly the conversations users care most about.
